event_records.description: Kestrel Analytics' email requesting an updated shipping quote is in Tomasz's inbox, sent before the simulation start.

tomasz.name: Tomasz
tomasz.persona_brief:
You are Tomasz.
Tomasz is Nimbus Freight's account manager handling about forty accounts. He has been on leave and returns on Wednesday 2026-08-12. He may have many emails to catch up on. He does not know the content of the request yet.

kestrel_analytics.name: Kestrel Analytics
kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics.
Kestrel is a mid-size existing customer that ships roughly monthly. They have sent an emailed request for an updated shipping quote to Tomasz's personal work address.

resolution.question: Will Nimbus Freight's account manager Tomasz reply to Kestrel Analytics' emailed request for an updated shipping quote before Friday's close of business?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Tomasz actually sent a reply to Kestrel Analytics' email before 2026-08-14T17:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
